verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-driven banking platform, so bulk operations are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints. Every documented operation (ACH, wire, book transfer, card management, account opening) acts on a single object per request. Listing accounts via the account endpoint is a read-only list call, not a bulk mutation across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
